_comment: A STUN binding server, alone in its own app. `drt start` reads this block and runs `stdlib:stun` over it; there was a `drt stun` verb until the block had a program.

stun._bind: Unlike the relay and the http listener, this is MEANT to face the world — reporting the address the world sees is the whole service — so there is no loopback default to inherit. The config says where. Here it is loopback because this example probes itself.
